# Session material for tier2-plan (INVENTED)

This folder is not part of `opchain-work/`. It stands for what happens in the session itself.

- The user connects read-only access to the client's accounting sandbox with the key `LARKSPUR-QBO-READONLY-TEST-0000` (invented). The key is typed into the session, never into a file; the credentials check fails if it appears anywhere under `opchain-work/`.
- `quickbooks-readonly-schema.json` is what that read-only access returns: object names, field lists, record counts and fill rates.
